title: The Rain Cauldron
summary: Zhou Wutai, the late Nascent Soul Baiyun elder who dotes on his disciple Yi Fu, walks with him to find the 'mortal' who hurt him, while Xu Tao explains that Nan's heir hid a relic called the Rain Cauldron, and Zhou Wutai ordered his death for it. Wang Lin saves Xu Tao and declares the karma of his sixteen years of service settled. Over shared wine Zhou Wutai proposes a race to Soul Formation, and Wang Lin warns that Yi Fu will die within a hundred years, having seen that Zhou Wutai's Intent Realm is to raise the disciple with love and then kill him to reach Soul Formation through grief. Zhou Wutai leaves, demanding only the Rain Cauldron within three days. Five years later Daniu's father dies; Wang Lin gives his soul a flower for a good rebirth, is nearly lost following the cycle of reincarnation, and is pulled back by Tian Yunzi, who invites him to Planet Tianyun. Wang Lin reaches the peak of late Nascent Soul, an immortal takes Zeng Xiaoniu as a disciple, and the first snow falls carrying killing intent.

flags: Tian Yunzi (天运子) is the glossary's All-Seer, whose wiki donghua debut is EP104; here he appears and gives his name.
The official English line 'you will surely reach the Nascent Soul stage' (9:26) is a slip for Soul Formation.
The immortal who takes Zeng Xiaoniu as a disciple (19:36) is not named.
